title: App Center
plugins: Plugins from other developers arrive in a later version.
noPermissions: This app needs no special permissions.
builtIn: Built-in apps get the permissions they declare.
uninstallBody: It disappears from the launcher, the dock, search and the command palette. You can install it again here at any time.
uninstallWipe: Also delete its data (documents, history, settings). Files in your folders stay.
clearConfirm: Delete all data of {name} (documents, history and settings)? Files in your folders stay. This cannot be undone.

vfs.title: Files
vfs.body: Read and change your files and folders.

clipboard.title: Clipboard
clipboard.body: Copy to and paste from the clipboard.

network.title: Internet
network.body: Connect to servers you set up.

ai.title: AI
ai.body: Use the AI server you configured.

intents.title: Open with
intents.body: Open files in other apps and share data with them.

system.title: System
system.body: Manage Nexus itself (built-in system apps only).
